spec2def(esent.dll esent.spec)

# esent.dll is all Rust (esent-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/esent-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled:
# esent_main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/esent-rust/src/esent/esent_main.rs)
# The cohab stub, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(esent_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(esent_shims PRIVATE libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
add_cargo_module(esent esent-cargo esent.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE esent-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS esent_shims)
